senses.gloss: m. ch. = h.בֶּדֶקbreaking into, freshet, bursting dam.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 66b:12">B. Mets. 66ᵇ</cite> <he>אתא ב׳ וכ׳</he> a freshet came and overflooded &c.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 41a:7">B. Bath. 41ᵃ</cite> <he>שקל בי׳ וכ׳</he> a freshet swept his field (taking away the fence).
<cite ref="Chullin 105a:12">Ḥull. 105ᵃ</cite> <he>צינורא דב׳</he> Ar. a channel caused by a freshet, v. <cite ref="B00155"><he>בְּדַק</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 7a">Snh. 7ᵃ</cite> strife is likened <he>לצינורא דבי׳</he> (<he>דמיא</he>) <he>וכ׳</he> to an inroad made by a burst (of water), once entering it widens more and more; a. fr.—Pl. <he>בִּדְקֵי</he>, <he>בִּידְקֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Eruvin 21a:8">Erub. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>דשכיחי בי׳</he> where freshets are of frequent occurrence.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 42:9">Targ. O. Gen. XLII, 9</cite> (h. <cite ref="P01321"><he>ערוה</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Kings 12:6">Targ. II Kings XII, 6</cite> sq.—Pl.

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Lamentations 1:8">Targ. Lam. I, 8</cite> <he>בִּדְקָהָא</he> her shortcomings (h. <he>עֶרְוָתָהּ</he>). [<cite ref="Bava Batra 61a:2">B. Bath. 61ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="B00158"><he>בדקא</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="B01319"><he>בַּרְקָא</he> III</cite>.]
